left.raw_text: Current or chronic history of liver disease
or known hepatic or biliary abnormalities
with the exception of Gilbert's syndrome
History of regular alcohol consumption within 6 months of the study defined as:

right.raw_text: An average weekly intake of >21 units for males or >14 units for females.

left.raw_text: One unit is equivalent to 8 gram of alcohol:

right.raw_text: a half-pint (approximately 240 milliliter [mL]) of beer, 1 glass (100 mL) of wine or 1 (25 mL) measure of spirits.
